title: Lost Summer Neg and Folio
body: Lost Summer Neg is the CN fit: fifteen pairs, twelve of them used for the fit. My first try only paled the reds, which broke the rule from the first week, so it was refitted until the colour came out strong and shifted.

Its first recipe, Folio, is set from a recipe I shoot on the camera: CN, Daylight with B−3, colour +2 and weak colour chrome. On the camera that recipe is DR400. In Fonder it opens at DR100, because Fonder's DR400 flattened this film where the camera's doesn't, and at DR100 it matched the camera's own frame of the same scene.

images.alt: Two strips of a small shop with a green roof and a red awning beside a pink wall, a woman in a blue dress in front: Folio 100 and no film.
images.caption: A generated street scene, not a photograph, cropped to the roof and the awning. Top: Folio 100. Bottom: no film. The sky pales, the green roof goes grey-teal, the red awning turns toward vermilion and the pink wall toward salmon. The camera's own frame that Folio was matched against is no longer shown here.
